info.syllabusName: Tiền lương và phúc lợi (Compensation and Benefits)
info.description:
This course includes: 

Chapter 1: The Pay model

Chapter 2: Determining the Structure

Chapter 3: Job-Based structure

Chapter 4: Person-based structure

Chapter 5: Designing Pay levels

Chapter 6: Pay for performance

Chapter 7: Employee benefits

Chapter 8: Benefits options

Chapter 9: Compensation of Special Groups

Chapter 10: International Pay system
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand concepts and methodologies related to compensation and benefits
Understanding various pay structures such as job-based, person-based and be able to analyze outcomes of each structure.
Demonstrate the importance of employee benefits and benefit options.
Analyze human resources’ differences to design benefits packages for different groups
Implement Ethics and professionalism in compensation and benefits from policies to practice
